title: Shawn Owen: Bitcoin’s First Institutional Cycle Has Arrived
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Shawn Owen: Bitcoin’s First Institutional Cycle Has Arrived Banks are racing to adopt Bitcoin, and SALT Lending CEO Shawn Owen says FOMO is real. He joins Grace and Sean to break down BTC lending and institutional shift. This post Shawn Owen: Bitcoin’s First Institutional Cycle Has Arrived first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
